from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime
import importlib.util,json,sys,psutil,re

BASE=Path('F:/nav_integration_g2_20261023');OUT=Path(__file__).parent
sys.path.insert(0,'D:/Desktop/SOC FPGA/nav/integration/g2')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('physical_stream',BASE/'pnr36_vs_pnr32_final_review1/review.py')
h=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(h)
h.NEW=BASE/'baseline_fusion_DSP_AREG_pnr47'

me=psutil.Process();me.nice(psutil.BELOW_NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS)
cache=h.load(h.CACHE);before,after=h.report(old),h.report(h.NEW)
targets=set(cache['selected_nets'])|{r['net']for t in(before,after)for r in t['globals']}

(OUT/'actual_storage_controls.json').write_text(json.dumps(actual,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
geometry={n:dict(kind=c['kind'],parameters=c['parameters'])for n,c in actual['memory'].items()}
assert geometry==cache['physical_memory_geometry'] and len(geometry)==after['resources']['BSRAM']==332
assert all(x['source']in geometry and x['added_after_pnr']['name']in geometry for x in cache['wide_pairs'])
assert len(cache['wide_pairs'])==18
full=h.load(BASE/'baseline_fusion_DSP_AREG_one_shot/actual_SYN33_review.json')
mapping=h.load(BASE/'baseline_fusion_DSP_AREG_one_shot/root_actual_DSP_AREG_mode_review.json')
assert full['passed']and mapping['passed']
public=h.LIB.read_text();macro=re.search(r'\bmodule MULTALU27X18\b.*?\bendmodule',public,re.S)[0]
parameter_text=re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/|//[^\n]*','',macro,flags=re.S)
defaults={k:v.strip()for k,v in re.findall(r'\bparameter\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*([^;]+);',parameter_text)}
assert defaults
first_checker_rejection='Raw explicit-only SYN parameters differ from PNR materialized public defaults. Resolve both against unchanged public model; reject all unknown keys and compare every effective parameter.'
dsps=[]
for c in full['private_DSP_AREG_actual_mapping']['action_DSPs']:
 p=actual['DSP'][c['name']]
 ports={k:h.bits(v)for k,v in p['ports'].items()}
 inputs=[k for k in c['ports']if k not in ['DOUT','CASO','SOB']]
 differences={k:dict(SYN=c['ports'][k],PNR=ports.get(k))for k in inputs if c['ports'][k]!=ports.get(k)}
 assert set(c['parameters'])<=set(defaults)and set(p['parameters'])<=set(defaults)
 resolved_source=defaults|c['parameters'];resolved_physical=defaults|p['parameters']
 param_diff={k:dict(SYN=resolved_source[k],PNR=resolved_physical[k])for k in defaults if resolved_source[k]!=resolved_physical[k]}
 dsps.append(dict(name=c['name'],parameters_identical=not param_diff,input_control_and_clock_ports_identical=not differences,parameter_differences=param_diff,input_differences=differences,all_effective_parameters=resolved_physical,actual=p))
(OUT/'actual_DSP_preservation.json').write_text(json.dumps(dsps,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
assert all(d['parameters_identical']and d['input_control_and_clock_ports_identical']for d in dsps)
cdc=h.load(h.NEW/'g2_gate.json')['cdc_first_stage_candidate']['physical_audit'];ref=h.load(old/'g2_gate.json')['cdc_first_stage_candidate']['physical_audit']
keys=('group','source_register','first_register','second_register','source_clock','target_clock')
signature=lambda c:sorted(tuple(p[k]for k in keys)for p in c['paths'])
assert cdc['passed']and ref['passed']and len(cdc['paths'])==26 and signature(cdc)==signature(ref)
rt=h.load(h.NEW/'tool_runtime.json');gate=h.load(h.NEW/'g2_gate.json')
assert not rt['cancelled']and rt['tool_exit']==1 and gate['unrouted_nets']==966
assert rt['max_runtime_s']==rt['max_no_observable_progress_s']==0
normalize=lambda p,r:p.read_text().replace(str(r),'<BUILD>').replace(r.as_posix(),'<BUILD>').split()
inputs=dict(CST=(old/'g2.cst').read_bytes()==(h.NEW/'g2.cst').read_bytes(),device=(old/'impl/pnr/device.cfg').read_bytes()==(h.NEW/'impl/pnr/device.cfg').read_bytes(),options=normalize(old/'impl/pnr/cmd.do',old)==normalize(h.NEW/'impl/pnr/cmd.do',h.NEW),SDC_same_as_PNR44=(h.NEW/'g2.sdc').read_bytes()==(BASE/'baseline_fusion_DSP_round_bias_pnr44/g2.sdc').read_bytes())
assert all(inputs.values())
